title: Facilitate payments as a platform
description: Facilitate direct payments to businesses on your platform from their own customers.

steps.title: Create and onboard a connected account
steps.description: Enable sellers (connected accounts) on your platform to accept payments from their customers.

nodes.title: Create an account
nodes.description: Create a connected account that can accept payments from its customers.

nodes.title: Create an account link
nodes.description: In your actual integration, create an account link to collect KYC information from your connected account, which will render a Stripe-hosted onboarding flow. Alternatively, you can use embedded onboarding to integrate the onboarding component into your application or use API onboarding to create a customized onboarding UI using Stripe's APIs.

nodes.title: Complete KYC data collection
nodes.description: Your connected account can use the generated account link to complete KYC data collection. This step isn't required for this example but will be necessary in your actual implementation.

steps.title: Accept embedded payments
steps.description: Create a charge directly on the connected account and immediately transfer a fee to your platform.

nodes.title: Create a checkout interface
nodes.description: Create a Checkout Session for the connected account to accept payments. The connected account's customer will be directed to a Stripe-hosted prebuilt payment form optimized for conversion. Alternatively, you can also embed a prebuilt payment form on your site or use the API to build a more customized checkout experience.

nodes.title: Accept a payment
nodes.description: The connected account's customer can then complete a payment on the checkout surface. Open the submitted app surface and fill in the test card information with the card number as 4242 4242 4242 4242 to run a successful payment. Use a valid future date and any three-digit CVC.

nodes.title: Verify that the payment is complete
nodes.description: Listen for the webhook event to identify if the payment successfully went through.

nodes.title: Review the completed payment
nodes.description: Retrieve the completed Checkout Session on the connected account and expand the PaymentIntent and latest Charge so you can confirm the payment's status, amount, and Connect fee context.
